fact: Standard Bank says it has expanded access to China's CIPS, settling cross-border payments directly in RMB, to clients in Lesotho among others.
TechCabal reports Lesotho migrant workers in South Africa send money home to Lesotho through the fintech Mukuru, after tighter South African banking rules.

Newsday reported that Sasai Econet Financial Services is adding inbound remittance corridors to EcoCash Lesotho through a partnership with Thunes, covering Zimbabwe, Tanzania, Europe, the UK and others, with a Botswana corridor due from October 2025.

The South African Reserve Bank directive says low-value cross-border electronic funds transfers within the Common Monetary Area (Eswatini, Lesotho, Namibia, South Africa) are currently executed through SADC-RTGS.

The South African Reserve Bank directive says Common Monetary Area low-value transfers, including this country's, run through the SADC-RTGS regional system and must move to the TCIB scheme by April 2027.

The CMA Cross-border Payments Oversight Committee's paper of 31 July 2024 says rand cross-border low-value EFTs within the Common Monetary Area, including Lesotho, run through an interim supplementary-file solution in place since 1 October 2019 and still in use.

The CMA committee's paper of 31 July 2024 says banks route low-value cross-border EFTs within the CMA, Lesotho among its four members, through the SADC real-time gross settlement system under the interim arrangement, to move to a designated retail system such as TCIB from 1 April 2027.

The South African Reserve Bank said that from 30 September 2024 low-value electronic funds transfers, debit and credit payments among Eswatini, Lesotho, Namibia and South Africa are treated as cross-border transactions with greater due diligence.

A Central Bank of Lesotho payments director said the regional infrastructure payment system of the Common Monetary Area already handles various payments within the area and beyond, and that low-value cross-border payments, until then routed as South African domestic payments, will move to it from September 2024.
system: Common Monetary Area regional infrastructure payment system
